description:
BRAHMAND is a team of passionate individuals who share a common interest in science, technology, research, and innovation. We believe in working together, exchanging ideas, learning new skills, and exploring creative possibilities. Our aim is to build meaningful projects, encourage curiosity, and grow through collaboration. United by our enthusiasm for discovery and innovation, we strive to explore new horizons and turn ideas into reality.

BRAHMAND Team Leader: Rishabh Rathore
